decisions.reason: Because the inbound SMS API is tightly aligned with the firm’s core secure communications platform, has already received standalone promotion and an earlier internal decision to back it, management is likely to stay committed and treat any modest uptake as temporary.

As a newly launched email-to-SMS gateway that is very close to the established offer and visibly marketed on its own page, it fits the firm’s announced multi-channel cloud strategy and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.

The SMS-to-email gateway is likewise a highly adjacent extension of the firm’s communication stack, and given the recent launch, visible commitment, and strategic fit, management would probably continue supporting it rather than reverse course quickly.
